disposition: The held packet does not support 120 attendees at three shows. Under the confirmed room window and current layout, at most two full shows and 72 audience admissions fit.
formula: Duration for n >= 1 shows = 10 + 25*n + 10*(n-1) + 10 minutes. Audience places per show = 42 - 6 = 36; separate crew positions are not subtracted from 36.

claim_specific_authority.extension_request_only: separate TENTATIVE event does not supersede confirmation
claim_specific_authority.audience_places: current revision 2 in layout.tsv; revision 1 is superseded

evidential_limits: 72 is a capacity ceiling for admissions, not an observed or forecast attendance count.
Demand and repeat visitors are not known.
A room extension is plausible but unconfirmed; even if granted, unchanged seats give 108 admissions across three shows, not 120.

present_plan_issues: Unconfirmed extension cannot be counted in current capacity.
The claim also uses obsolete audience capacity.
future_implementation_conditions: Confirm named volunteer lead and helper rota before ticket release if proceeding.
Obtain venue confirmation if pursuing the extension; a different layout or venue needs its own assessment.
optional_evidence_improvements: A demand survey could improve attendance forecasting.

action_scope: Assess held plan only; do not book, contact, release tickets, change reservations, assert approval, or claim operational readiness from a capacity calculation.
